features.name: compressor_M5_post
mates: ruthex RX-M5x9.5
compressor rubber grommet, washer and M5 screw
notes: One of four repeated compressor mounts; retain the grommet seating height.
100% infill is a native print region, not represented by this solid.

features.name: condenser_M3_corbel
mates: condenser upper flange hole and M3 screw
notes: Upper finger is an exact source section; grow its standing fin down into broad wall/floor stock.

features.name: condenser_sheet_rail
mates: condenser thin flange sheet
notes: Complete crown groove retains its seated floor and rising 45-degree roof; support-free opening.

features.name: cold_core_corner_stop
mates: native rounded cold-core cap corner and flat front datum
notes: One of two mirrored locating corners; round and flat contacts are distinct constraints on the same seat.

features.name: MQ6_card_chute
mates: MQ-6 board ends and can, with header lead access
notes: Preserve both complete opposed grooves and their blind bottom shoulders; top and header access remain open.

features.name: cold_core_hold_down
mates: cold-core cap crown and incoming crown edge
notes: Retain the trapezoid gusset, flat bearing face and 1 mm incoming-edge lead.

features.name: Beduan_V69_four_post_seat
mates: one Beduan valve, all four mounting posts and both port channels
notes: One complete four-post footprint represents the press fit; retain body clearance without reaming the sockets.

features.name: wall_cable_clip
mates: braided loom across the display backing wall
notes: Keep the complete two mouths, S-entry ramps and 3 mm backing.

features.name: tee_carrier_working_section
mates: one complete outer tee and two ties
two real return springs in the one retained column
matching fixed release journal and window roof/floor
one sliding window cover
features.group: fixed plumbing rear partition with actual moving tee carrier
notes: Only repeated tee stations are omitted; the complete one-column working length, spring bores, R6 rounds and capture gap remain.
The cropped carrier section needs its open inner edge joined to the drawer’s native structure; it is not a free loose coupon.
Support-free additive R6 and 0.08 top-round recipe retain the accepted source scope; force, spring return and four-collet simultaneity are not accepted by it.

features.name: electronics_M3_mount
mates: identified PCB / relay mounting datum
M3 insert and screw
notes: Do not collapse a ceiling-column variant into a corbel or transfer its physical load claim.
Print-down is +world Z because back-top prints ceiling-down.

features.name: Wago_413_well
mates: Wago 221-413 with working wire levers
notes: Use one connector-size family; preserve its insertion direction, end tabs and lever access.
Index 0 is an authentic ceiling-column-backed well; index 5 is a wall corbel variant.

features.name: flow_meter_collar_pair
mates: both fixed collars of the actual flow meter
two nylon zip ties
notes: The two collars are a necessary physical mate on one meter; retain both source seats.
The two ties carry the meter; an open-down bore alone retains nothing.

features.name: flow_meter_matched_hardware_roof_rooms
mates: both fixed collars of the actual flow meter
two nylon zip ties
notes: Move these pockets with the matching source anchor, using the same origin and rotation.
The anchor and tie exits are separate; restore only native bearing stock after roof pockets, then keep its own tie channels open.
Full hardware and plumbing-line clearance remains a distinct assembly question.

features.name: ASSE_stepped_hex_anchor
mates: the stepped ASSE threaded chain
two wide nylon zip ties
notes: The three stepped contact sections retain actual round/hex profiles and longitudinal capture.
Keep the complete common channel and its ceiling exit; no support-access claim follows from geometry alone.

features.name: asse_matched_hardware_roof_rooms
mates: the stepped ASSE threaded chain
two wide nylon zip ties
notes: Move these pockets with the matching source anchor, using the same origin and rotation.
The anchor and tie exits are separate; restore only native bearing stock after roof pockets, then keep its own tie channels open.
Full hardware and plumbing-line clearance remains a distinct assembly question.

features.name: tube_anchor_2
mates: tube or fitting of the stated source radius
nylon zip tie
features.group: plumbing run on side wall / ceiling
notes: Keep axis-plane truncation, full 3 mm flat lips and both tie-channel mouths.
The matching tube diameter is a geometry datum; the print is not the fluid passage.

features.name: complete_rear_funnel_joint
mates: source-profile square rail head and complete slipped receiver
native concentric silicone collar/brim quadrant; full silicone bowl is not recreated
features.group: back-top plumbing roof; source joint is the removable lid
notes: The full rear rail is retained; no engagement length, open lead, stop or catch is cropped.
The source front pair is repeated hardware and is outside this exact rear-corner section.
Native +Z frame and -Z receiver print directions remain; broad supported catch faces need the source support recipe.
Final cabinet seating/removal clearance is layout-specific. Physical force, retention and cleanup of this section are unprinted.

bearing.active_section: whole native rear rail and complete R27 rear-quarter brim turn
bearing.removal_route: Remove front-top, withdraw drawer, release grip and Y fasteners, set front-bottom aside; slide local−Y37mm, then lift+Z.
bearing.review_scope: zero receiver overlaps at twelve sampled -Y positions from 0 through 45 mm; final cabinet furniture clearance remains parent-owned

features.name: C14_tunnel
mates: C14 purchased inlet with dog-bone flange
two M3 inserts and screws
IEC cord
features.group: rear service wall with ceiling root
notes: Keep its complete two-ear pocket and straight inboard insertion path.
The source aperture bridge is part of the actual cord tunnel.

features.name: PRV_escape_chase
mates: PRV discharge tube and open atmosphere
paired Z-seam wall shares
features.group: west wall below the cold core
notes: Cut the chase after both source shares join their walls; do not close the show-skin exit.
Upper and lower shares retain opposite native print directions.

comparisons.native_wall_band_convention: Local print Z from each crossmember foot plane.

M3.nominal_screw: M3 x 8: 5.5 mm pilot engagement with the default foot/pad datums; 0.2 mm tip clearance.
M3.scope: Geometric fastening option; current root pad and assembled crossmember load/fit remain unprinted.

comparisons.support_access: Both Y ends of the native lifting opening remain open before bolting to the drawer. Remove support with the crossmember loose.
comparisons.service: Remove front-top, then withdraw whole drawer and all three crossmembers together. Unbolt individual roofs only on the withdrawn drawer.
comparisons.identity: Helvetica bold 4 mm code on exterior vertical roof stock, 0.48 mm relief; active underside is unmarked.

physical_scope.accepted: Identified native grip receiver coupon support removal and assembled fit.
physical_scope.limits: These three full-span roof crossmembers, new floor pads and fasteners are unprinted. Source evidence supplies no lifting-load or repeated-use claim.

native_cabinet.native_y_receiver_scope: Added ASSEordinary side wall receives exact original rear-shell air; source FT plug and original BT stock are preserved.

hybrid.hybrid_half_plane: X=0; Industrial X<0, Sculpted X>0 below Z67.5; complete Industrial upper remains
hybrid.common_mounting_cavities: Both source halves retain the same native plate sockets and donor envelope; only exterior style differs.

binary_stl_join.scope: Coplanar center-join STL reconstruction only; analytic CAD and non-planar source faces unchanged.

donor.adaptation: Printed dimensional donor reference rooted into the source above-counter plate. Inactive shank ends at plate underside Z−4; above-counter envelope is retained. Port moved +0.125 mm in Y to source tube axis +8.875. Added nominal Ø2.4 plunger rod and observed-diameter transverse bar.
donor.retention_scope: Source lever channel/ledges around nominal bar, source neck/tube bay and native M3 plate/base fastening. Modeled alignment only; physical friction, insertion, movement and load untested.

intentional_elastic_interference.FS/FPD: TPU thimble Ø10.44 in nominal Ø10 port; expected undeformed overlap, not a rigid-clearance defect.

counter_gasket_mounting_scope.adaptation: Three Ø3.9 through-perforations on the unchanged source plate/base M3 axes for the cabinet fastener stack; all other source gasket lands retain their geometry.
counter_gasket_mounting_scope.scope: Two-millimetre source gasket with declared cabinet-joint perforations. Compression, sealing and load acceptance do not transfer to this unprinted stack.

faucet_review.scope: Exact-source nominal CAD placement and current hybrid construction only. No physical insertion, friction, spring force, seal, loading or life claim. Counter/core integration and fastening hardware remain separately reviewed.
